title: Width bound for a concatenation of DNF formulas
statement: Let $\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_s$ be DNF formulas over $n$ variables, and let $\ell$ be a natural number such that each $\varphi_i$ has width at most $\ell$ (that is, every term of every $\varphi_i$ contains at most $\ell$ literals). Then the DNF formula obtained by concatenating all of their term lists into a single list of terms also has width at most $\ell$.
